sections.heading: What is trending: “ipca 15”
paragraphs: “ipca 15” appeared on Google Trends' Trending Now list for BR (snapshot taken 2026-08-26T13:16:19+00:00 UTC). Google reports at least 200 searches for this term — that figure is a lower bound published in the official Trends feed, not an exact count.

sections.heading: Timeline
paragraphs: The trend entry was published to the Google Trends feed at Wed, 26 Aug 2026 05:30:00 -0700. Our snapshot was taken at 2026-08-26T13:16:19+00:00 UTC and this briefing was assembled at 2026-08-26T13:17:30+00:00 UTC.

sections.heading: How to read these numbers
paragraphs: Google Trends reports approximate search volume as a lower bound (for example “20K+”). Actual volume can be significantly higher. Trending status reflects acceleration in searches, not the absolute size of a topic. For the full story behind the spike, read the cited coverage below — this briefing intentionally adds no speculation beyond the sourced facts.
